rows: MW: Pumping down string and kill line from cement unit WBM 11,2 ppg @ 0,4 bpm/ 80 psi for friction. Close IBOP and fail safe valve at kill line. Perform surface line pressure test with 300/2000 psi for 5/5 min. Perform hang off at UPR with SO 30 klbf.
MW: Stablish ciculation for PWD data recovering.
MW: Drill new formation 12 1/4" from 3410 to 3418 m with 25 - 30 klbf, 80 rpm / 5 - 20 klbf ft, 850 gpm / 2700 psi, MW 11,2 ppg, ECD 11,43 ppg.

MW: Perform procedure for underreamer activation. POOH from 3418 m to 3410 m. Stop circulation and drop 2" activation ball. RIH till 3417 m (bit 1m above bottom). Circulate WBM 11,2 ppg @ 150 gpm, 210 psi, 30 rpm, 4 klbft, without pressure spike as expected by Halliburton procedure.

MW: Increase flow rate from 150 gpm till 750 gpm / 2290 psi at 50 gpm steps, verifying torq spikes from 400 gpm/760 psi on. Stop circulation and POOH drom 3417 to 3412 m. Perform carry out test against rat hole bottom with 750 gpm / 2260 psi @ 3415 m (bit depth) with 25 klbf.
MW: Perform down link and take SCRs (after reamer activation) with MPs #1 e #2.
MW: Enlarge to 13 1/2" from 3374 até 3377 m with 11 klbf, 45 rpm, 10-35 klb ft, 850 gpm, 2700 psi, MW 11,2 ppg, ECD 11,4 ppg.
